name: Personnel Area / Subarea
description: 4-phase wizard to define Personnel Areas (regions), Personnel Subareas, and company code assignments

regions.description: Personnel Areas representing organizational regions or divisions

name.description: Region/area display name (e.g. Southwest, Corporate HQ)

needsSubareas.description: Whether this region has personnel subareas defined

subareas.description: Personnel Subareas within regions (SAP T001P entries)

description.description: Subarea description (SAP T001P BTEXT, max 15 chars)

companyCodeAssignment.description: Mapping of regions to company codes (same for all or per-region)

companyCodeMode.description: Whether all regions share one company code or each gets its own

globalCompanyCode.description: Shared company code when mode = same

regionCompanyCodes.description: Map of regionId -> companyCode when mode = individual

orgType.description: Organization structure type selected in phase 1

differenceFactors.description: Factors that drive subarea differentiation (e.g. pay, benefits, pto)

completion.rule: Zustand persisted store with currentScreen = '4.1' (review screen) and regions array with at least one entry

dataAccess.notes: Reads company codes from turbosap.company_code.draft.v1.* via cross-module localStorage scan
